description: Code quality lint rules for Python — enforces type hints, clean logging, and safe patterns

logging.description: Enforce structured logging over print statements

rules.description: No print() in production Python — use logging module
rules.message: Replace print() with logging.info/debug/warning for structured output

rules.description: Public functions should have type hints
rules.message: Consider adding type hints to public functions for better IDE support and safety

rules.description: No bare except — always specify the exception type
rules.message: Bare 'except:' catches all exceptions including SystemExit — use 'except Exception:' or a specific type

rules.description: No mutable default arguments (list, dict) — shared across calls
rules.message: Mutable default arguments are shared across all calls — use None and assign inside the function

rules.description: Input schemas (Create/Update/Request/Payload) must not inherit from StrictBaseModel
rules.message: StrictBaseModel (strict=True) must only be used for response/output schemas. Input schemas ending in Create, Update, Request, or Payload must use a non-strict base (BaseModel or a project-level lax InputModel) so that FastAPI can coerce types during request validation. Using StrictBaseModel on input schemas produces HTTP 422 for clients sending valid JSON with coercible types (e.g. string->Decimal).
